Dave Matthews Band
November 4, 2022
Climate Pledge Arena - Seattle, WA

*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*
*=*=*=*=* 16/48 RECORDING *=*=*=*=*
*=* NOT SUITABLE FOR CD BURNING *=*
*=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=* *=*=*=*=*=*

Mixing: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 6 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: GA Floor, House Right Rear Rail, Aligned w/ House Right Stack, Approx. 45' from Stage, Mics PAS @ 14'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.69 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > WAV (32 Bit Float @ 48) > Audacity 3.2.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

19. Kill the Preacher
20. Why I Am
21. Jimi Thing⁶
22. Louisiana Bayou

26. Two Step⁷

Set Time: [03:01:08.901]

Dave Matthews Band:

Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

¹ Daniel Lanois cover
² Thank You (Falettinme Be Mice Elf Agin) interpolation
³ with Carter solo intro
⁴ Peter Gabriel cover
⁵ Bob Dylan cover, with Mike McCreedy on Guitar, with Mike McCreedy solo intro
⁶ with Skerik on Tenor Sax, with Flash Light interpolation
⁷ with Time Bomb intro

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.
